The committed binding hash does not match `future_family_delta`: running the added `--check` gate recomputes `c996...` on Python 3.11.15 and `35a5...` on Python 3.12.13, rather than the stored `c5dd...`. Therefore `issue_1774_p4_momentum_semantic_kg.py --check` fails with `materialized output drift` and the new test suite fails in `setUpClass`; regenerate the release manifest from the final provider implementation.

+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_41_q02::q02/a": ("p_continues", "p_reverses"),
+}
+
+# Cross-Family procedures materially used inside otherwise Momentum-primary
+# parts. They remain candidate support until their owning Family is reconciled.
+SUPPORTING_METHODS = {
+    "qrow_9709_m22_qp_42_q07::q07/b": ("relative_motion",),
+    "qrow_9709_m23_qp_42_q07::q07/a": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_s20_qp_41_q07::q07/a": ("kinematics",),
+    "qrow_9709_s20_qp_41_q07::q07/b": ("energy", "kinematics"),
+    "qrow_9709_s21_qp_41_q03::q03/b": ("relative_motion",),
+    "qrow_9709_s22_qp_41_q07::q07/a": ("newton", "kinematics"),
+    "qrow_9709_s22_qp_41_q07::q07/b": ("newton", "kinematics"),
+    "qrow_9709_s25_qp_41_q05::q05/a": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_s25_qp_41_q05::q05/b": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_s25_qp_42_q02::q02": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_w20_qp_41_q01::q01/b": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_w22_qp_41_q02::q02": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_w24_qp_42_q05::q05/b": ("kinematics",),
+    "qrow_9709_w24_qp_43_q04::q04": ("energy",),
+    "qrow_9709_w25_qp_41_q06::q06": ("kinematics",),
+}
+
+
+def _load(relative: str) -> Any:
+    return json.loads((ROOT / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def _receipt(relative: str):
+    return sha256_and_length((ROOT / relative).read_bytes())
+
+
+def _momentum_inventory(previous: Mapping[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    active_ids = {item["question_id"] for item in previous["question_parts"]}
+    topic_by_question = {
+        row["question_row_id"]: row["primary_topic_path"]
+        for row in _load(SOURCE_MAP)["rows"]
+        if row["paper_number"] == 4 and row["question_row_id"] in active_ids
+    }
+    topic_by_question.update(
+        {
+            question_id: topic
+            for question_id, topic in p402.p401._legacy_topic_authority().items()
+            if question_id in active_ids and question_id not in topic_by_question
+        }
+    )
+    topic_by_question.update(
+        {
+            question_id: topic
+            for question_id, topic in p402.p401.TOPIC_GAP_AUTHORITY.items()
+            if question_id in active_ids and question_id not in topic_by_question
+        }
+    )
+    inventory = {
+        question_id
+        for question_id, topic in topic_by_question.items()
+        if topic == MOMENTUM_TOPIC
+    }
+    if len(inventory) != 39:
+        raise RuntimeError("live Momentum inventory drifted")
+    return inventory
+
+
+def _authenticated_bundles(
+    inventory: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for manifest_path in sorted(
+        ROOT.glob("artifacts/**/checker-visual-bundle-manifest.v5.json")
+    ):
+        records.extend(_load(str(manifest_path.relative_to(ROOT)))["bundles"])
+    selected = [item for item in records if item["question_id"] in inventory]
+    if len(selected) != 39:
+        raise RuntimeError("Momentum active visual bundle count drifted")
+    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for item in selected:
+        bundle_path, portable_path = p402.p401.resolve_authenticated_corpus_path(
+            item["path"], CORPUS_ROOT
+        )
+        raw = bundle_path.read_bytes()
+        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != item["sha256"]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"bundle SHA-256 drift: {bundle_path}")
+        bundle = json.loads(raw)
+        result[item["question_id"]] = {
+            "active_bundle_identity": bundle["packet_id"],
+            "bundle_path": portable_path,
+            "bundle_sha256": item["sha256"],
+            "qp_page_refs": [
+                p402.p401._image_ref(image)
+                for image in bundle["qp_complete_page_chain"]
+            ],
+            "ms_page_refs": [
+                p402.p401._image_ref(image)
+                for image in bundle["ms_complete_page_chain"]
+            ],
+        }
+    if len(result) != 39:
+        raise RuntimeError("duplicate Momentum active bundle identity")
+    return result
+
+
+def _momentum_kind(part_id: str) -> str:
+    if part_id in DEFINITION_PARTS:
+        return "definition"
+    if part_id in COALESCENCE_PARTS:
+        return "coalescence"
+    if part_id in SEPARATION_PARTS:
+        return "separation"
+    return "collision"
+
+
+def _anchors(prefix: str, refs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
+    return [
+        f"{prefix}:sha256:{ref['sha256']}:page:{ref['page_number']}"
+        for ref in refs
+    ]
+
+
+def _append_instance(
+    instances: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    steps: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    *,
+    part_id: str,
+    definition: Mapping[str, Any],
+    family: str,
+    status: str,
+    role: str,
+    branch_key: str,
+    qp_anchors: list[str],
+    ms_anchors: list[str],
+    alternative_to: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    model_id = f"9709.p4.pm.{definition['model']}"
+    instance_id = (
+        f"{part_id}::procedure-instance::{role}::{branch_key}"
+    )
+    record = {
+        "branch_key": branch_key,
+        "classification_evidence_refs": qp_anchors + ms_anchors,
+        "family": family,
+        "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": ms_anchors,
+        "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+        "procedure_model": {
+            "definition": definition["model_definition"],
+            "procedure_model_id": model_id,
+        },
+        "procedure_model_ref": model_id,
+        "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": qp_anchors,
+        "question_part_id": part_id,
+        "role": role,
+        "status": status,
+    }
+    if alternative_to is not None:
+        record["alternative_to"] = alternative_to
+    instances.append(record)
+    for index, evidence in enumerate(definition["steps"], start=1):
+        steps.append(
+            {
+                "procedure_instance_id": instance_id,
+                "procedure_step_instance_id": f"{instance_id}::step:{index}",
+                "sequence_index": index,
+                "status": status,
+                "step_evidence": evidence,
+            }
+        )
+    return instance_id
+
+
+def build_reviewed_source() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    previous = _load(P402_SOURCE)
+    inventory = _momentum_inventory(previous)
+    if inventory != set(QUESTION_VISUAL_FACTS):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "pixel-reviewed Momentum inventory mismatch: "
+            f"missing={sorted(inventory - set(QUESTION_VISUAL_FACTS))}, "
+            f"stale={sorted(set(QUESTION_VISUAL_FACTS) - inventory)}"
+        )
+    bundles = _authenticated_bundles(inventory)
+    previous_parts = {
+        item["question_part_id"]: item for item in previous["question_parts"]
+    }
+    live_part_ids = {
+        part_id
+        for part_id, item in previous_parts.items()
+        if item["question_id"] in inventory
+    }
+    governed_part_ids = (
+        set(FOREIGN_PART_METHODS)
+        | DEFINITION_PARTS
+        | COALESCENCE_PARTS
+        | SEPARATION_PARTS
+        | set(BRANCHES_BY_PART)
+        | set(SUPPORTING_METHODS)
+    )
+    if governed_part_ids - live_part_ids:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "reviewed Momentum QuestionPart authority drift: "
+            f"{sorted(governed_part_ids - live_part_ids)}"
+        )
+
+    new_parts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    new_instances: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    new_steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for part_id, old in sorted(previous_parts.items()):
+        qid = old["question_id"]
+        if qid not in inventory:
+            new_parts.append(old)
+            continue
+        role = old["role"]
+        owner_path = part_id.split("::", 1)[1]
+        visual = bundles[qid]
+        foreign_methods = FOREIGN_PART_METHODS.get(part_id, ())
+        if role == "instruction_only":
+            status = "abstain"
+            definition = None
+            family = None
+        elif foreign_methods:
+            status = "candidate"
+            definition = FOREIGN_DEFINITIONS[foreign_methods[0]]
+            family = definition["family"]
+        else:
+            status = "approved"
+            definition = MOMENTUM_DEFINITIONS[_momentum_kind(part_id)]
+            family = "momentum"
+
+        qp_anchors = _anchors("qp", visual["qp_page_refs"])
+        ms_anchors = _anchors("ms", visual["ms_page_refs"])
+        record = {
+            "active_bundle_identity": visual["active_bundle_identity"],
+            "classification_rationale": (
+                "Instruction/context node; the complete QP chain was reviewed "
+                "but it carries no independent score semantics."
+                if role == "instruction_only"
+                else "The exact QP/MS pixels make a foreign-Family method "
+                "primary; it remains candidate-only for its owning Family."
+                if foreign_methods
+                else "The exact QP/MS pixels show a Momentum definition or "
+                "conservation event with explicit signed topology."
+            ),
+            "ms_evidence_anchor_refs": (
+                ms_anchors if role == "score_owning" else []
+            ),
+            "qp_evidence_anchor_refs": (
+                qp_anchors if role == "score_owning" else []
+            ),
+            "question_id": qid,
+            "question_part_id": part_id,
+            "role": role,
+            "status": status,
+            "terminal_disposition": status,
+            "visual_review": {
+                **visual,
+                "authority_source": (
+                    "predecessor_bound_worker_pixel_review_with_"
+                    "successor_high_risk_reopen"
+                ),
+                "checkpoint_path": VISUAL_CHECKPOINT,
+                "material_visual_facts": [
+                    f"For owner {owner_path}: {QUESTION_VISUAL_FACTS[qid]}"
+                ],
+                "part_visual_authority_key": part_id,
+                "reviewed_all_ms_pages": role == "score_owning",
+                "reviewed_all_qp_pages": True,
+                "reviewed_shared_or_inherited_context": True,
+                "rationale": (
+                    "The predecessor-bound worker authenticated and opened the "
+                    "complete QP/MS chain; the successor authenticated and "
+                    "reopened the ambiguous sign/topology sample before "
+                    "integrating the part-level classification."
+                ),
+            },
+        }
+        if definition is not None:
+            model_id = f"9709.p4.pm.{definition['model']}"
+            question_type_id = f"9709.p4.qt.{definition['question_type']}"
+            candidate_families = (
+                list(
+                    dict.fromkeys(
+                        FOREIGN_DEFINITIONS[method]["family"]
+                        for method in foreign_methods
+                    )
+                )
+                if foreign_methods
+                else []
+            )
+            record.update(
+                {
+                    "candidate_family": (
+                        candidate_families[0] if candidate_families else None
+                    ),
+                    "candidate_families": candidate_families,
+                    "procedure_model_ref": model_id,
+                    "question_type": {
+                        "definition": definition["question_type_definition"],
+                        "question_type_id": question_type_id,
+                    },
+                }
+            )
+            branch_keys = BRANCHES_BY_PART.get(
+                part_id,
+                (
+                    f"foreign_{foreign_methods[0]}"
+                    if foreign_methods
+                    else _momentum_kind(part_id),
+                ),
+            )
+            core_id = _append_instance(
+                new_instances,
+                new_steps,
+                part_id=part_id,
+                definition=definition,
+                family=family,
+                status=status,
+                role="core",
+                branch_key=branch_keys[0],
+                qp_anchors=qp_anchors,
+                ms_anchors=ms_anchors,
+            )
+            for branch_key in branch_keys[1:]:
+                _append_instance(
+                    new_instances,
+                    new_steps,
+                    part_id=part_id,
+                    definition=definition,
+                    family=family,
+                    status=status,
+                    role="supporting",
+                    branch_key=branch_key,
+                    qp_anchors=qp_anchors,
+                    ms_anchors=ms_anchors,
+                    alternative_to=core_id,
+                )
+            for method in foreign_methods[1:]:
+                supporting = FOREIGN_DEFINITIONS[method]
+                _append_instance(
+                    new_instances,
+                    new_steps,
+                    part_id=part_id,
+                    definition=supporting,
+                    family=supporting["family"],
+                    status="candidate",
+                    role="supporting",
+                    branch_key=f"supporting_{method}",
+                    qp_anchors=qp_anchors,
+                    ms_anchors=ms_anchors,
+                    alternative_to=core_id,
+                )
+            for method in SUPPORTING_METHODS.get(part_id, ()):
+                supporting = FOREIGN_DEFINITIONS[method]
+                _append_instance(
+                    new_instances,
+                    new_steps,
+                    part_id=part_id,
+                    definition=supporting,
+                    family=supporting["family"],
+                    status=status,
+                    role="supporting",
+                    branch_key=f"supporting_{method}",
+                    qp_anchors=qp_anchors,
+                    ms_anchors=ms_anchors,
+                    alternative_to=core_id,
+                )
+        new_parts.append(record)
+
+    reviewed = [item for item in new_parts if item["question_id"] in inventory]
+    reviewed_counts = Counter(item["status"] for item in reviewed)
+    role_counts = Counter(item["role"] for item in reviewed)
+    if len(reviewed) != 108 or role_counts != {
+        "instruction_only": 27,
+        "score_owning": 81,
+    }:
+        raise RuntimeError("reviewed Momentum QuestionPart count drifted")
+    if reviewed_counts != {
+        "abstain": 27,
+        "approved": 50,
+        "candidate": 31,
+    }:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"reviewed Momentum disposition drifted: {dict(reviewed_counts)}"
+        )
+    qp_paths = {
+        ref["path"] for bundle in bundles.values() for ref in bundle["qp_page_refs"]
+    }
+    ms_paths = {
+        ref["path"] for bundle in bundles.values() for ref in bundle["ms_page_refs"]
+    }
+    if (len(qp_paths), len(ms_paths)) != (57, 92):
+        raise RuntimeError("complete Momentum image-chain inventory drifted")
+
+    cumulative_instances = list(previous["procedure_instances"]) + new_instances
+    cumulative_steps = list(previous["procedure_step_instances"]) + new_steps
+    cumulative_types = {
+        item["question_type_id"]: item for item in previous["question_types"]
+    }
+    for item in reviewed:
+        if item["status"] in {"approved", "candidate"}:
+            value = item["question_type"]
+            cumulative_types[value["question_type_id"]] = value
+    cumulative_models = {
+        item["procedure_model_id"]: item for item in previous["procedure_models"]
+    }
+    for instance in new_instances:
+        value = instance["procedure_model"]
+        cumulative_models[value["procedure_model_id"]] = value

The whole-source conservation gate checks all 648 ProcedureInstances and reports 0 ProcedureInstance/model mismatches. P4-02 source and delta hashes remain exact.
